operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. EG-001 through EG-101, EG-201, EG-401, and EG-501) and fire pump (Ref. Nos. FWP-01 through FWP-03)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Operate and maintain according to manufacturer's written instructions or approved procedures; only change settings permitted by manufacturer and do not increase air emissions.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. EG-001 through EG-101, EG-201, EG-401, and EG-501)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: No operation for scheduled maintenance checks, readiness testing, stack testing, or operation training (involving fuel combustion) between 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during May 1 through September 30.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. EG-001 through EG-101, EG-201, EG-401, and EG-501) during integration operational period
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Operation (involving fuel combustion) between 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during May 1 through September 30 only if forecast AQI for ozone for Northern Virginia is <= 100. If Air Alert issued for forecasted AQI <= 100, operation shall be minimized.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. EG-001 through EG-101, EG-201, EG-401, and EG-501)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Operation only for: sudden unforeseeable events (grid failure, on-site disaster, public service emergencies); ISO-declared emergencies; scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing; unscheduled maintenance, testing and operational training; and integration operational period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each individual emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. EG-001 through EG-101, EG-201, EG-401, and EG-501)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Not more than 30 hours per year for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing. Not more than 500 hours per year for all purposes combined. Annual limits calculated monthly as sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each fire pump (Ref. Nos. FWP-01 through FWP-03)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Not more than 500 hours per year for all purposes combined. Annual limits calculated daily as sum of each consecutive 365-day period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. EG-001 through EG-101, EG-201, EG-401, and EG-501) and fire pumps (Ref. Nos. FWP-01 through FWP-03)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Ultra-low sulfur diesel fuel oil, hydrotreated vegetable oil (HVO), and blends. Must meet ASTM D975 for grade ultra-low sulfur 2-D or 2-D S15, or have max sulfur content 0.0015% by weight (15 ppm) and either min cetane number 40 or max aromatic content 35 volume percent.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. EG-001 through EG-101, EG-201, EG-401, and EG-501) and fire pumps (Ref. Nos. FWP-01 through FWP-03) combined
operationalLimits.limitDetails: No more than 665,850 gallons of total ultra-low sulfur diesel fuel oil and HVO per year, calculated daily as the sum of each consecutive 365-day period.
